scope: user-approved hidden-desktop map-pan diagnostic runs on the protected stable stage, used to view frames and verify harness repairs; not short-ladder, replacement-cohort, endurance or promotion evidence
capture: host ReadProcessMemory reads of the 8-bit software surface through the non-presenting proxy

runs.finding: every retained-file read rejected; frames after the first forced pan mixed stale and redrawn cells; edge PNGs grayscale; the short configuration also produced no heartbeat row and incomplete final pan coverage
coherent repainted frames and palette PNGs; only the candidate .exe retained read was still rejected

all retained frames, logs, proxy files, templates, patch report and candidate reopened and matched; every frame coherent after each pan; superseded pan mechanism (injected repaint from the redraw entry)
every pan step taken by the native arrow-key handler landed exactly on the planned four-phase cycle; frames coherent; redraw rate back near the unforced map rate

defects_repaired: retained reader compared path lstat with handle fstat st_ctime_ns; on Windows Python 3.12+ these mean creation time and last metadata change, so every real file was rejected; cross-API identity now uses creation time

retained reader compared extension-derived st_mode execute bits that Windows lstat reports for .exe paths and a nameless handle never reports, on every Python version; cross-API identity now ignores only those bits

forced map-pan wrote the scroll fields without the native full repaint, so the incremental redraw left stale cells; a first repair injected the repaint 00418700 from the redraw entry, which left the render-device global changed mid-frame, so each pan step is now taken by the native arrow-key handler 00407D20 at its own main-loop call from CDB-written key state (pan_mechanism cdb_forced_native_arrow_key)
edge PNGs were rendered from grayscale indices although the proxy retains the DirectDraw palette; they now use that palette when its 1024-byte dump is complete

dry-run plan and approval preflight fixture tests built sealed completed-ladder artifacts outside the private reader scope and ignored the retained patch fault; they now use that scope, apply the fault and assert fresh-process fail-closed behavior
